products.description:
BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER - Gama alta, con un gran control y tacto muy agradable.

La BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER siendo una pala muy polivalente, se nos presenta como una de las que más control nos va a aportar a nuestro juego.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Para jugadores que busquen un plus en golpes de calidad, un magnifico manejo y adaptable desde nivel avanzado.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Empezando por su formato, la BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER es una pala con un formato lágrima, en búsqueda siempre de un muy buen equilibrio y priorizando un poco más el control, con una distribución de 60% control y 40% potencia.

En cuanto a los marcos, tienen un doble tubular en carbono, haciéndola muy resistente y estable.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

products.englishTitle: Black Crown Special Master - Black Crown
products.englishDescription:
BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER - High-end, with great control and a very pleasant touch.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER, being a very versatile racket, is presented to us as one of the ones that will provide us with the most control in our game.

PLAYER TYPE

For players looking for a plus in quality shots, magnificent handling and adaptable from an advanced level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Starting with its format, the BLACK CROWN SPECIAL MASTER is a padel racket with a teardrop format, always seeking a very good balance and prioritizing control a little more, with a distribution of 60% control and 40% power.

It has 12K carbon faces that ensure a very resistant response, combined with a core with SSB Black Eva rubber, which is a very pleasant soft rubber, this model being the Black Crown with a softer feel in 2024. It also has a sand-like roughness, thus making it easy to hit hits with spin.

Este nuevo modelo de Softee para la temporada 2026 es de lo más interesante gracias a su novedoso formato redondo, con un puente aerodinámico que nos permitirá una movilidad más rápido y mejor durante todo el partido. 

Destacamos su color rojo metalizado.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Está pensada para jugadores que quieren una pala equilibrada, con buena pegada pero sin perder control. No es una pala radical en un solo aspecto: busca ese punto medio que permite defender con seguridad y acelerar cuando el punto lo pide.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

La SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K su nombre nos deja claro cual es el material principal de la pala, la fibra de carbono 3K. Este material nos aporta una mayor rigidez en los planos, lo que se traduce en una salida de bola más directa y una respuesta firme en golpes ofensivos.

El nuevo puente aeroinámico no es solo un detalle visual. Ayuda a reducir vibraciones y mejora la estabilidad en el golpeo.

Además, la superficie rugosa arena, facilita la generación de efectos, y en parte aumenta el control.

We highlight its metallic red color.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SOFTEE REBOUNCE RED 3K, its name makes it clear to us what the main material of the racket is, 3K carbon fiber. This material gives us greater rigidity in the planes, which translates into a more direct ball output and a firm response on offensive shots.

The new aerodynamic bridge is not just a visual detail. Helps reduce vibrations and improves stability when hitting.

In addition, the rough sandy surface facilitates the generation of spin, and partly increases control.

products.title: Drop Shot Revenge Pro - Drop Shot
products.description:
DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO - Versatility, power and control in a mold created by the first Conquerors of magician Juan Lartín Díaz. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot brings us reissues of its most legendary padel rackets, such as this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO, a racket in offensive format, with great punch and a sweet spot with which to keep up with the pace of the match.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO is made for advanced or professional level players. Offensive players with good finishing who get the most out of this model.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The features of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO make it one of the highest quality Drop Shot paddles. Its format is teardrop, which gives us greater punch and aggressiveness in our blows. However, its balance is spectacular, feeling comfortable and easy to handle.

In its construction, Drop Shot uses 360 curved triaxial carbon on the face of the racket, a premium material in high-end padel rackets that achieves great touch and punch in our shots. Its frame incorporates double carbon tubular for greater durability.

For the core, Drop Shot uses quality high-rebound Eva Soft rubber, which provides optimal precision and ball feel to give everything in our matches and have exceptional control along with a great punch.

The rough touch appears on the faces, which improves the effects of our sliced ​​shots, thanks to the 3D rhomboid-shaped texture, patented by Drop Shot.

It incorporates an anti-vibrator in the heart of the racket, to reduce vibrations to a minimum and a silicone piece that is inserted into the handle of the racket, to improve vibrations even further if possible.

BLADE DESIGN

The DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO opts for a design in striking colors such as red, black and fluorescent yellow for the logo. A sensational choice by Drop Shot.

PLAY STYLE

The recommended playing style of this DROP SHOT REVENGE PRO are those styles with aggressiveness and punch in the blows, but with a good feeling of control.

products.title: Wilson Defy Ls V1 2025 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON DEFY LS V1 2025 - A good weapon for punchers, lightness, elegant style and aggressive roughness. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The Wilson Defy Ls v1 2025 is a racket with a very outstanding design, with matte gold and black tones. It stands out for its roughness and its weight of 355 grams. 

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is indicated for advanced level players who like to hit the ball and at the same time give it a lot of spin on topspin and slices.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The Defy Ls V1 has a diamond-shaped mold, optimal for a high and fast ball game. Manufactured with different thickness of holes (I-Beam system) facilitating its handling and air passage. Its light weight (355g) and medium-high balance make it a very interesting option for attacking players. The frame is made of carbon, giving it a lot of consistency and its faces are made of CONFORT FLEX Fiberglass, generating high comfort in different hits. Inside we have Power Foam, a compound that exceptionally absorbs the vibration of the impact of the ball, highly recommended for cases of epicondylitis. 

PLAY STYLE

Due to its composition we can affirm that the racket, in addition to being manageable and light, surprises in its response to high balls, vipers and hits. If spin attacks are your thing, don't miss this opportunity, the Defy Ls leaves no one indifferent.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro - Arturo Coello - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO - The new jewel in the crown of Head Padel. Worn by Arturo Coello, the world number 1. Racquet of incredible power, diamond shape and with the best technologies. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Discover your wildest side with the new HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO, which will be the racket used by the number 1 in the world, Arturo Coello, one of the young promises of this sport who in such a short time as a professional has managed to reach the top. This 2023 season and those to come, he will use this weapon, the Extreme Pro model, a diamond-shaped, aggressive racket, with high balance that generates extreme power in each hit.

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this racket only for those players with an aggressive profile and who control attacking rackets. It is a racket that will surely take us to the next level in terms of power. If you play both forehand and backhand and are looking for the best power, this is yours.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We are going to know in detail everything that one of the best Head rackets brings: the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO.

As we have already mentioned, it is the official racket of the professional player Arturo Coello, a new racket launched by Head to highlight the aerial power of its players. The diamond shape is the true protagonist, a high balance format but respecting a large sweet spot to also have good control. Its weight is 370 grams, which is ideal for delivering high power to blows.

Among its materials and technologies, we highlight Auxetic technology, which gives us greater power on impact and softness in blows when we want control.

In its framework we highlight Graphene, which is the material responsible for providing us with the greatest durability in that area. For its part, in the plane area we have a hybrid composition that combines carbon fiber and fiberglass, on a Power Foam rubber.

It is also rough. It incorporates Extreme Spin technology, to make our blows have more effect.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, the HEAD EXTREME PRO - ARTURO COELLO is an extreme racket as its name indicates. Indicated to secure the points as close to the network as possible. For players who want to get the best vipers and finishes.

In defense it also performs great, as Head emphasizes this by incorporating flexible materials such as Foam rubber in the core.
